question: Four bells begin to toll together at 8.00 am and then each one at intervals of 5 s, 6 s, 7 s and 8 s respectively. How many times will they toll together in a shift of 7 hours?
solution:
Given:

Interval of four bells are 5 s, 6 s, 7 s, and 8 s

Concept used:

To calculate the intervals of all bells tolling together is to take the L.C.M of the respective intervals.

Calculation:

L.C.M of 5, 6, 7, 8 =

 [IMAGE: https://storage-googleapis-com.cdn.ampproject.org/ii/AW/s/storage.googleapis.com/tb-img/production/21/01/F1_Debasmita_29.12.20_Pallavi_D2.png] 

Given four bells are tolling together at an interval of 840 s or in 840 s, bells are tolling together only one time.

⇒ 840 s = (840)/(60) = 14 minutes

Given time span = 7 h = 420 minutes

In 420 minutes, bells are tolling together = (420)/(14) = 30 times

Total number of times all bells rang together in 7 hours

= 1 at the beginning + 30 times

= 31 times

∴ They toll together 31 times in 7 h (Once they have tolled at the start).

Hence, the correct answer is option 4).
